description: This file defines a singleton utility struct `SessionActions` containing static methods for managing sessions within a macOS application. It primarily facilitates session patching, resetting, deleting, compacting, and displaying session-related alerts and logs, by interfacing with a `ControlChannel` for network requests and using AppKit's `NSAlert` for user dialogs.

methods.name: patchSession
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a patch request for a session with optional thinking and verbose levels.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Asynchronously resets the session identified by the given key.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the session identified by the given key and deletes its transcript.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Asynchronously compacts the session transcript up to a maximum number of lines.

methods.name: confirmDestructiveAction
methods.description: Displays a warning alert prompting the user to confirm a destructive action, returning true if confirmed.

methods.name: presentError
methods.description: Displays an alert with an error message.

methods.name: openSessionLogInCode
methods.description: Attempts to open a session log in code editor, or reveals it in Finder if not possible.
